set.missingPermission: I can't send messages in {channel}. Grant View Channel + Send Messages there and try again.
set.invalidChannel: That doesn't look like a channel I can post embeds in.

disable.success: Disabled **{kind}** logging. Its channel mapping is kept, so `/logs set {kind} ...` re-enables it without re-picking a channel.

retention.success: Retention set to **{days}** day(s). The server-wide data retention policy may shorten this further.

redact.notFound: No custom redaction pattern matches `{pattern}`. Use `/logs redact list` to see the current list.
redact.limitReached: You already have the maximum of {max} custom redaction patterns. Remove one first.
redact.builtIn: Built-in (always on): email, phone, Discord token, credit-card-like numbers, IPv4 address

test.success: Sent a sample **{kind}** log — check its configured channel (and `/logs search` if storage is on).

search.title: Log search: {kind}
search.noResults: No matching log events found for that user/filters.

errors.storeEventsOff: Log storage is off for this server (`storeEvents=false`), so `/logs search` has nothing to search. Turn it back on with the dashboard or `/logs` settings.
